description: This file defines the Coocook::Model::UnitConversionGraph class, which models a directed graph of unit conversions, including methods for creating the graph from a database result set, querying conversion factors, and checking convertibility between units.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::UnitConversionGraph
classes.description: Represents a graph of unit conversions with methods to query conversion factors and convertibility.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructs a new UnitConversionGraph object from a database result set of conversions, building a directed graph and its transitive closure.

methods.name: graph
methods.description: Returns the underlying directed graph object.

methods.name: tcm
methods.description: Returns the transitive closure matrix object.

methods.name: factor_between_units
methods.description: Calculates the conversion factor between two units if reachable.

methods.name: can_convert
methods.description: Checks if one unit can be converted into another.

methods.name: unit_convertible_into
methods.description: Returns all units directly reachable from a given unit.
